description: Reviewed provenance ledger for the bridge-finish authority check (tools/verification/m01-bridge-finish-v2-authority.mjs --provenance). Each entry lists a protected path whose bytes at main differ from the historical pin, the approved sha256 at main, and the commit(s) already on main that introduced those bytes. The verifier accepts a protected file only if it equals the pin or the approved hash with every approving commit an ancestor of the PR base and holding those bytes. Regenerate a DRAFT only with m01-bridge-authority-ledger-draft.mjs and review before committing; entries are append-only evidence.
